prompts.norse-3d: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium stylized 3D tabletop chess miniatures for a JavaScript game. Output a genuine transparent alpha PNG atlas, wide 3:2 canvas. EXACTLY 12 pieces in 6 columns and 2 rows. Top row WHITE faction ivory/white materials with restrained gold accents and pale circular plinths; bottom row BLACK faction charcoal/black with restrained silver accents and dark circular plinths. Same character designs and poses for both factions. Natural skin tones where appropriate. Columns KING, QUEEN, BISHOP, KNIGHT, ROOK, PAWN, in that exact order. Every full miniature completely visible with all equipment contained in its cell, generous transparent gaps, no overlap, no cropping. Small circular plinths, base aligned within each row. King tallest, pawn shortest. Readable silhouettes at small game sizes, refined miniature sculpting, consistent orthographic three-quarter camera slightly above, soft upper-left lighting. NO background, NO floor, NO board, NO shadows outside plinths, NO checkerboard pattern, NO text, NO labels, NO watermark. All accessories must touch their figure physically, no floating disconnected details. Theme and role designs:  Critical layout: each figure occupies at most 85% of cell width and 85% of cell height, leaving a clear fully transparent horizontal band between rows. Entire weapons and headpieces must fit within margins. Norse mythology. King Odin, one-eyed bearded ruler with crown and close upright spear; queen Freyja, regal braided goddess with crown and cloak; bishop hooded runic seer holding staff; knight Viking riding a compact wolf; rook sturdy runestone tower; pawn Viking warrior with round shield. Carved knotwork and restrained Nordic details. Odin's spear must be SHORTER than his crown height. Keep very wide transparent horizontal band between rows, at least 60 pixels. No object may extend into the other row. Fit all miniatures within their cells.
